title: Symmetry-first candidate-space audit after action-selection blocker
question: Does the pre-soft-s RTK archive contain any independently motivated projectable symmetry/degeneracy completion that already fixes a full nonlinear action sufficiently to reopen s6fT without using the failed soft-s observable?

decision_rule.SOURCE_LOCKED_PROJECTABLE_CANDIDATE_FOUN: Only if an archived pre-soft-s candidate is projectable and supplies a full nonlinear action, field map, lapse/shift dependence, action-derived source direction, and complete coupled constraint architecture.
decision_rule.NO_SOURCE_LOCKED_PROJECTABLE_CANDIDATE_F: If every audited route is either explicitly quadratic/incomplete or explicitly nonprojectable/incomplete. Retain s6fT and s6fX blockers.

scope: Archive candidate-space audit only; absence of a source-locked candidate is not a no-go for future projectable completions.
